dhp179:2: jitaṁ yassa noyāti → jitamassa no yāti (bj, sya-all) | yassa noyāti → assa no yāti (pts) | yassa → jitamassa (cck: sī. syā. pī.); jitaṁ massa (cck: ka.)
dhp179:4:
nessatha → yasya jitaṁ nātha jīyati jitamasya na jināti anhakaඃ 
tambuddhamanantagocaraṁ apadaṁ kena padena neṣyatha (bj: mahavastu 3. 92 piṭa)
dhp180:4:
nessatha → yasya jālinī visattikā. tṛṣṇā nāsya kahimpi netrikā. 
tambuddhamanantavikramaṁ apadaṁ kena padena neṣyatha (bj: mahāvastu 3. 92 piṭa)
dhp183:4:
sāsanaṁ → sarvapāpasyākaraṇaṁ kuśalaseyyāpasampadā 
svacittaparyādāpaṇametadbuddhānuśāsanam (bj: mahāvastu 3. 420 piṭa)
dhp184:4: na →  (bj, sya-all, pts) | na → ayaṁ nakāro sī. syā. pī. pātthakesu na dissati (cck note)
dhp185:1: anūpavādo anūpaghāto → anupavādo anupaghāto (sya-all, pts) | anūpaghāto → anupavādo anupaghāto (cck: syā. ka.)
dhp188:4:
bhayatajjitā → bahavaඃ śaraṇaṁ yānti parvatāṁśava vanāni ca 
ārāmacaitya vākṣāṁśva manuṣyā bhayatarjitāඃ (bj note)
dhp189:4:
pamuccati → na pabhyataccharaṇaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ naitaccharaṇamuttamam 
naitaccharaṇamāgamya sarvaduඃkhāt pramuvyate (bj note)
dhp190:4:
passati → yasatu buddhaṁ ca dharma ca saṅghaṁ ca śaraṇaṁ gataඃ 
āryyasatyāni catvāri paśyati prajñayā sadā (bj note)
dhp191:4:
dukkhūpasamagāminaṁ → duඃkhaṁ duඃkhasamutpādaṁ duඃkhasya samatikram 
āryyaṁ cāṣṭāṁgikaṁ mārgaṁ kṣemaṁ nirvāṇagāminam (bj: udānavarga 17 28-31)
dhp192:4:
pamuccati → etaddhiśaraṇaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ etaccharaṇamuttamam 
etaccharaṇamāgamya sarvaduඃkhrān pramucyate (bj: udānavarga 27-31)
dhp193:4:
sukhamedhati → dulībhaඃ puruṣājanyo nāsau sarvatra jāyate. 
yatrāsau jāyate vīraඃ tat kulaṁ sukhamedhate (bj: mahāvastu 3 109 piṭa); dulabho pauruṣa jaño na so sarvatra jayati. 
yatra so jayati viru ta kulu suhumedhati (bj: prā. dha. C VD 35)
dhp194:4:
sukho → buddhānāṁ sukhamutapādaඃ sukhā dharmasya deśanā 
sukhā saṅghasya sāmagri śramaṇānāṁ tapassukham (bj: prātimokṣa sūtra 9)
